title: Gaussian generator domain and Hermite coefficients
statement: Let $n\ge 0$ and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be square-integrable with respect to the product of $n$ standard Gaussian measures. Then $f$ belongs to the domain of the Gaussian generator if and only if the sum over all multi-indices $\alpha\in\mathbb N^n$ of $|\alpha|^2\widehat f(\alpha)^2$ is finite, where $|\alpha|=\sum_{j=1}^n\alpha_j$ and $\widehat f(\alpha)$ is the Hermite coefficient of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is square-integrable for product standard Gaussian measure
